threads.body: i wonder if this method can be in utils instead, and all instrumentations can be updated to use it ? I think we have the same issue in all instrumentations ?

replies.body: Yes, I think the same shape is elsewhere. In the OpenAI instrumentation, for example, `create_chat_invocation` runs before the `try` in `patch.py`, and malformed message input can raise there when content capture is enabled. I kept this one Bedrock-only on purpose: a shared helper would be new util-genai API, so I'd rather agree on the approach first. Would you prefer an issue for a util-level helper, with this PR staying as the Bedrock fix, or should I fold it in here? Either way, I'm happy to take the follow-up for the other instrumentations.
lets try putting it in utils and updating all instrumentations to use it..
Moved it to util-genai as `suppress_extraction_errors()`, and bedrock, openai, anthropic, portkey, google-genai and smolagents use it now. The description lists the remaining gaps.

threads.body: We should not guard against arbitrary objects whose __str__ raises where the SDK expects a string. This is outside the expected input contract, and the same kind of failure could occur anywhere, including in the exception handler or exporting pipeline
